# VPSMonitor v0.2.68

## Changes
- Preserve custom Realm forwarding rule names when client-reported realm snapshots are merged back into managed config.
- Show custom Realm forwarding names in area-manager authorization selections and assignment views.
- Use custom Realm forwarding names for Realm-exported x-ui client display tags when available.

## Validation
- `go test ./...`
- `npm run build`
